hero.headline: One company, building for every industry
hero.subheadline: We started with restaurants. Here's what's live today, and what's coming next.

products.name: Browser Based POS
products.headline: Free offline POS, right in your browser
products.description: A completely free point-of-sale for small businesses. Bill customers, manage products and inventory, hold and recall carts, and print thermal receipts — no login, no subscription, and it keeps working without internet. All data stays on your device, with one-click backup and restore.
features: Fast billing with barcode scanner support
Works fully offline
Hold and recall carts mid-rush
Credit (udhaar) sales and customer ledger
Inventory & stock tracking with movement log
Customers & purchase history
Sales, payment and best-seller reports
Thermal (80mm/58mm) & A4 receipt printing
PIN counter lock with idle auto-lock
JSON backup / restore, CSV exports & Google Sheet sync

cta.label: Open Browser Based POS — it's free

products.name: Bank Statement Analyzer
products.headline: Free bank statement analysis, right in your browser
products.description: A completely free bank statement analyser for chartered accountants and anyone who keeps a set of books. Import a PDF, Excel or CSV statement, classify every transaction with rules you control, reconcile against your ledger and export CA reports — no login, no subscription, and the statement is never uploaded anywhere.
features: Imports PDF, XLSX, XLS and CSV — including password-protected PDFs
Nothing is uploaded: parsing and analysis run in your browser
Extraction checked against the statement's own running balance
Deterministic rules-based classification with visible confidence
Business, personal and transfer marking separate from the category
Several statements analysed together, with duplicates excluded
Monthly cash flow, expense, income and counterparty analysis
Cash, high-value, bank charge, interest and transfer reports
Ledger reconciliation with exact, date-window and fuzzy matching
Excel workbook, PDF report and CSV exports generated on device

cta.label: Open Bank Statement Analyzer — it's free

products.name: Setu QR Menu
products.headline: A QR code that never needs reprinting
products.description: Your menu lives online and the printed QR code holds only a short permanent link. Change a price, mark a dish sold out or swap in a seasonal menu — the code on your tables keeps working. Dish photos, sizes and variations, multiple menus and daily scan counts — free for your first year.
features: One permanent QR code, printed once
Instant price and menu changes
Sold-out toggles & dish photos
Sizes and variations per dish
Multiple menus you can switch between
Daily scan analytics
Hygiene grade and certificate on the menu
Three templates with editable colours

products.name: Tuition Class Manager
products.headline: Free tuition software, right in your browser
products.description: A completely free class manager for a tuition teacher. Students and batches, daily attendance, monthly fees that add themselves up, WhatsApp reminders to parents, test marks and shareable fee receipts — no login, no subscription, and it keeps working without internet.
features: Batch-wise daily attendance in seconds
Works fully offline
Automatic monthly fee dues, concessions and one-off charges
Numbered fee receipts with shareable links and UPI payment
WhatsApp fee reminders and absence notices to parents
Tests with whole-batch marks entry and result sharing
Student-left handling that stops fees but keeps the history
Your own custom fields per student, e.g. school test marks
Dated diary reminders and admission enquiry register
Bulk student import, PIN lock, backup and Google Sheet sync

cta.label: Open the Tuition Class Manager — it's free

Table management
Tax-ready billing engine
QR order tracking & waiter call
Coupons & discounts
